description: Conversion of the existing detached outbuilding to a self contained residential unit with associated private amenity space, car parking, cycle and refuse storage.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal would involve the development of a self-contained home within the curtilage of an existing dwelling while conflicting with other policies of the Development Plan. The application would therefore not align with the presumption set out in Local Plan policy SC1 and would be unacceptable in principle.

Reason : 2 - The application fails to meet the requirements of Local Plan policy EC2 as it does not include an Energy Statement aligned with the London Plan energy hierarchy setting out how the proposal would improve the thermal performance and sustainability credentials of the property, or meet the net zero carbon requirements of the London Borough of Hounslow.

Reason : 3 - The proposed development would provide a substandard quality of accommodation, by reason of the inadequate means of access to the site, inadequate internal and external space standards together with privacy concerns for habitable rooms facing onto the shared rear access track. The application has also failed to show how future occupiers would be protected from harmful noise and air quality within the area. The proposal would therefore run contrary to Local Plan policy CC2, SC5, EC2, EQ4 and EQ5 and the aims and objectives of the London Plan

Reason : 4 - The proposal would result in an unacceptable reduction to the rear garden of the host property at no.83 Francis Road and would also result in a loss of privacy to occupiers of this address, as a result of future occupiers being able to cross their land to access the new dwelling. The proposal would therefore conflict with Local Plan policy CC1, CC2 and SC4 and the aims and objectives of the London Plan.

Reason : 5 - The application has not demonstrated that suitable or adequate waste and recycling facilities store with sufficient capacity and within a suitable location can be provided contrary to adopted Local Plan Policy EQ7
